facts.text: Beth dumped me, the paperboy wants his money, and Mom made another mystery dinner.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Lane never says this. His lines on the Moviemistakes page are about the paperboy not getting a dime, his brother and the microwave and so on. The paperboy's real line there is 'Didn't ask for a dime. Two dollars.'
facts.fix: Didn't ask for a dime. Two dollars.

fix_note.text: Didn't ask for a dime. Two dollars.
